heuristic_statement: Dual-Track Asymmetric Ground-Truth & Lifespan Reconciliation Heuristic: (1) Operational Ground Truth Track: Present executable code, orchestration workflows, and runtime configurations define what the machine deterministically enforces today; neither specification text (Agents.md), descriptive skill documents, retired definitions, nor historical model self-reports constitute proof of executable enforcement. (2) Requirement Provenance & Lifespan Track: Historical Git lineage and persisted execution records establish the origin, evolution, and supersession of user requirements. Requirement lifecycle (Active vs. Partially Superseded vs. Fully Superseded) and implementation status (Deterministically Enforced vs. Partially Implemented vs. Unenforced/Missing vs. Misrepresented) are treated as orthogonal dimensions. Superseded requirements create no present corrective work. (3) Grounded Interpretation Layer: Every historical semantic decision must strictly follow raw facts -> interpretations -> truth decisions with explicit evidence locators. (4) Corrective Work Criterion: An outstanding gap exists if and only if a user requirement survives as active or partially active, yet today's executable machine fails to deterministically implement or enforce it.
decomposition_rationale: The historical archive contains diverse evidence types spanning runtime code, canonical specifications, workflow orchestrations, multi-branch Git lineages, detailed patch logs, and 16 persisted nonce run containers. To avoid Gemini input token exhaustion, isolate evidence domains, and maintain strict adherence to the <= 250,000 bytes per subquestion context limit, the audit is decomposed into 24 sequentially executable subquestions: (a) audit trigger scope and metadata, (b) executable runtime behavior and deterministic enforcement, (c) workflow maintenance and auxiliary control artifacts, (d) canonical specification contracts and evaluation heuristics, (e) chronological Git lineage and requirement evolution, (f-g) scoped patch histories for Step 3 evaluation and workflow modifications, and (h-x) granular subquestions covering every supplied nonce run. Large oversized files (>250k) are decoupled, and each sub-evaluator receives only specific, bounded files paired with targeted interpretation directives.

completeness_strategy: Context Ceiling Enforcement: Every planned subquestion strictly complies with the <= 250,000 bytes manifest size limit, with the largest context totaling 245,142 bytes (SQ11).

Exhaustive Nonce Accounting: All 16 distinct nonce run containers from the manifest are explicitly audited across SQ08 through SQ24. For oversized run containers where individual files exceed 250k (specifically skill_bootstrap_update_20260930T170700 and large state/messages/store files), requirement lineage, runtime behavior, and supersession are verified via the Git lineage (SQ05) and targeted sibling runs (SQ11, SQ12, SQ18, SQ19).

Rigorous Fact -> Interpretation -> Truth Decision Pipeline: Each sub-evaluator is instructed to isolate objective observations (source code AST, raw patch lines, JSON fields) from semantic interpretations before arriving at normative truth decisions regarding requirement validity or supersession.

Orthogonal Lifecycle vs Implementation Dimensions: Requirements recovered from Agents.md, Git commits, and prompt histories will be categorized along two independent axes: Lifecycle State (Active, Partially Superseded, Fully Superseded) and Machine State (Implemented & Enforced, Partial, Missing/Unenforced, Misrepresented).

Corrective Work Identification: Only requirements proven to be Active today that lack deterministic implementation or enforcement in today's executable source (send-to-gemini.js, workflows, config) will be classified as outstanding defects requiring present corrective work.

Subquestion Synthesis and Contradiction Reconciliation: Subsequent synthesis will ingest all 24 sub-evaluation results sequentially, reconcile conflicting claims between descriptive specifications and executable code, and report explicit unresolved ambiguities.
